about: Seed evidence curated by the team's biomedical member. PMIDs, journals and years come from PubMed; the one-line claims are the team's summaries and should be checked against the papers.

papers.title: De novo mutations in the gene encoding STXBP1 (MUNC18-1) cause early infantile epileptic encephalopathy
papers.label: Saitsu 2008
papers.claim: Original report that de novo STXBP1 variants cause early infantile epileptic encephalopathy.

papers.title: Protein instability, haploinsufficiency, and cortical hyper-excitability underlie STXBP1 encephalopathy
papers.label: Kovacevic 2018
papers.claim: Patient variants make the Munc18-1 protein unstable and lower its cellular level.

papers.title: Stxbp1/Munc18-1 haploinsufficiency impairs inhibition and mediates key neurological features of STXBP1 encephalopathy
papers.label: Chen 2020
papers.claim: Mice with one working Stxbp1 copy show seizures and cognitive, psychiatric and motor problems.

papers.title: SNAREopathies: Diversity in Mechanisms and Symptoms
papers.label: Verhage & Sørensen 2020
papers.claim: Reviews diseases of the synaptic vesicle fusion machinery together, including STXBP1 and CPLX1.

papers.title: Genes that Affect Brain Structure and Function Identified by Rare Variant Analyses of Mendelian Neurologic Disease
papers.label: Karaca 2015
papers.claim: First report of homozygous loss-of-function CPLX1 variants in families with neurologic disease.

papers.title: Variants in CPLX1 in two families with autosomal-recessive severe infantile myoclonic epilepsy and ID
papers.label: Redler 2017
papers.claim: Homozygous CPLX1 variants in two unrelated families; recessive inheritance.

papers.title: STXBP1 encephalopathy: A neurodevelopmental disorder including epilepsy
papers.label: Stamberger 2016
papers.claim: Cohort study of the symptoms and seizure types in STXBP1 encephalopathy.

papers.title: Mechanism-based rescue of Munc18-1 dysfunction in varied encephalopathies by chemical chaperones
papers.label: Guiberson 2018
papers.relation: reports a second mechanism and a chaperone approach
papers.claim: Some variants act dominant-negatively; chemical chaperones restored protein levels in models.
